Loss report: gitlab -> argo
[external] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/adhoc/step/source-checkout step.action: input git artifact at /workspace (the ctx-repo and ctx-sha workflow parameters carry the repository and the commit; a private repository needs credentials on the git artifact, which the file does not set; a private repository needs usernameSecret and passwordSecret, or sshPrivateKeySecret, on the git artifact; the file names none)
[external] pipeline/gitlab-ci/trigger/0 trigger.manual: empty context parameters; argo submit --from workflowtemplate/gitlab-ci (a manual run starts the template with no value for ctx-repo, ctx-sha; a checkout then clones https://github.com/.git. Pass the values with argo submit -p, or set them under spec.workflowSpec.arguments; start a run with: argo submit --from workflowtemplate/gitlab-ci; the Workflow object needs a ServiceAccount with the rights in .argo/rbac/)
[emulated] pipeline/gitlab-ci/job/adhoc/step/script step.shell: container command sh with a bash-if-present wrapper (the source runs the step under bash when the image has it; the container runs bash -e when the image has bash, else sh -e, so bash-only syntax fails under sh)
